Plot a scRhythmModuleHeatmap object

Source: R/plot_module.R
plot.scRhythmModuleHeatmap.Rd

This S3 method draws one module-specific heatmap from a scRhythmModuleHeatmap object returned by plot_module_heatmap().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'scRhythmModuleHeatmap'
plot(
  x,
  module_id,
  title = NULL,
  draw_separators = TRUE,
  separator_lwd = 1.2,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A scRhythmModuleHeatmap object returned by plot_module_heatmap().

module_id

An integer specifying which module to draw.

title

A character value specifying the plot title. If NULL, the stored module title is used. Defaults to NULL.

draw_separators

Logical; if TRUE, separators are drawn between phase blocks. Defaults to TRUE.

separator_lwd

A numeric value specifying separator line width. Defaults to 1.2.

...

Additional arguments passed to ComplexHeatmap::draw().

Value

Invisibly returns the drawn ComplexHeatmap object.
